example_sentences.sentence: They plan to found a small library for the local community.

example_sentences.sentence: He helped found the group that supports young local artists.

entries.example_sentence: She started a blog to share her travel experiences with readers around the world.
entries.sentence_ipa: /ˈʃiː ˈstɑɹtɪd ə ˈblɔɡ ˈtuː ˈʃɛɹ ˈhɜr ˈtɹævəl ɪˈkspɪɹiːənsɪz ˈwɪð ˈɹiːdɜrz ɜrˈaʊnd ðə ˈwɜrld/
